name: photo-field-tools
description: Capture-time photography calculators for a Nikon Z50-class APS-C pair, one visible and one internally IR-converted. Offline-first installable PWA; no server, no account, no telemetry.

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build && npm run gate:a11y && npm run gate:acceptance && npm run gate:offline && node ../noahjefferson/pin-check.mjs --repo .

//runtime-deps: Doctrine §16.3 — declare every dependency. suncalc is the ONLY runtime dependency and it is BUNDLED by vite, never CDN-loaded (spec §10). Everything else is build/test/gate tooling and never reaches the browser.
//browser: playwright-core 1.56.0 ships chromium revision 1194, matching /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194 in the session sandbox. A MATCHED PAIR — a mismatched playwright-core connects and then hangs on a protocol mismatch with no error. Same pin as the hub; re-verify if the sandbox browser changes.
